symptom: Embedded Codex MCP in this fork can talk to /Applications/Nomi.app instead of the running Nomi-H3 Electron, so freeze/assemble/export never hit the open canvas.
direct_cause: Dev launcherEntry() reused a packaged Nomi.app Helper whenever that binary existed, and Codex config refresh rewrote mcp_servers.nomi to that path on startup.
class_root: MCP launcher identity was derived from a sibling install path instead of the currently running Electron process.
affected_population: Developers who also have official Nomi installed at /Applications/Nomi.app
Embedded Codex director and any Claude/Cursor one-click MCP install from a unpackaged fork
entry_points: launcherEntry() / mcpServerEntry() for Claude, Codex, and Cursor
internal_only_reason: The launcher is Nomi's own Electron Helper identity. No provider API or third-party MCP protocol change is required to decide that the running process is the only legal target.
invariants: Unpackaged Nomi always emits a development MCP launcher whose NOMI_MCP_APP_COMMAND is process.execPath and whose app path is app.getAppPath().
Unpackaged Nomi never selects /Applications/Nomi.app as the MCP GUI target.
pnpm dev sets NOMI_MCP_FORCE_DEV_LAUNCHER=1 so any remaining packaged-preference branch stays fail-closed.

recurrence.reason: Any unpackaged Electron that shares the Nomi.app product name can bind Codex/Claude/Cursor to the official install instead of the running fork.
same_class_scan: Searched installedMacLauncher, /Applications/Nomi.app, NOMI_MCP_FORCE_DEV_LAUNCHER, and mcpServerEntry call sites in electron/capabilityCore and electron/codexAppServer.
Confirmed Claude JSON, Cursor JSON, and Codex TOML all share launcherEntry(); packaged isPackaged path still uses process.execPath.
Confirmed ipc.ts refreshCodexNomiLauncher() rewrites ~/.codex/config.toml from mcpServerEntry() on every director start.

prevention.strategy: Delete the sibling-install preference. Unpackaged launchers bind the running Electron identity only, and pnpm dev forces the development launcher.

migration: No persisted project migration. The next director start or MCP install rewrites mcp_servers.nomi to the running Electron. A leftover ~/.codex config pointing at /Applications/Nomi.app is classified launcher-stale and auto-migrates when the launcher kind is packaged; unpackaged sessions rewrite on refreshCodexNomiLauncher().
residual_risks: A user who manually edits mcp_servers.nomi to a custom proxy remains in configState=custom and is not overwritten.
Packaged Nomi-H3 still uses process.execPath; if that binary is itself named Nomi.app it is the running product, not a sibling.
